name: TrayBuddy
description:
Tidy up the top bar: choose which indicator icons are always shown, which tuck away behind an arrow, and which are never shown.

Click the arrow to slide the tucked-away icons out. They collapse again after a few seconds without use. Drag to reorder icons in the settings.

Works with application tray icons (via the AppIndicator extension) and icons added by other extensions. Clipboard: Settings → About → Copy Debug Info copies a report to the clipboard when you click it.
